name: Carousel / Slider
summary: Finite, user-controlled horizontal scroll-snap carousel with named slide groups, canonical Icon Button navigation, synchronized pagination and status, native direct scrolling, and no implicit autoplay or looping.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Named carousel region and positioning context.

anatomy.name: slide
anatomy.description: Single named group with slide roledescription and position in set.

anatomy.name: nav
anatomy.description: Positioning wrapper for previous or next navigation.

anatomy.name: navButton
anatomy.description: Canonical Icon Button for previous or next slide navigation.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Polite status text synchronized with the visible slide.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default carousel gap and navigation size.

states.name: navHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on navigation controls.

states.name: trackFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on the native scroll viewport.

states.name: dotFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus on a pagination control.

behavior.name: scrollSnap
behavior.description: The track scrolls horizontally and each slide snaps to the start edge.

behavior.name: navigation
behavior.description: Canonical Icon Buttons move to adjacent slides and are disabled at finite collection bounds; the root does not intercept arrow keys from descendant content.

behavior.name: pagination
behavior.description: Dots should expose and synchronize the current slide.

behavior.name: directScrolling
behavior.description: Native direct scrolling synchronizes the current dot, disabled navigation, and polite status after the nearest slide changes.

behavior.name: finiteCollection
behavior.description: The v1 primitive does not autoplay or loop. A future autoplay option requires an explicit pause control and a new accepted contract decision.

behavior.name: motionControl
behavior.description: Reduced motion disables authored smooth scrolling and dot transitions.

properties.name: current
properties.description: Marks an individual pagination dot as representing the current slide.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables an individual previous or next navigation control when no adjacent slide exists.

accessibility: Name the carousel region and expose each slide as a named group with its position in the finite collection.
Provide descriptive alt text for images and accessible names for previous, next, and pagination controls.
Synchronize the visible slide, aria-current dot, finite navigation bounds, and polite status after buttons, dots, touch, wheel, or keyboard scrolling.
Do not intercept arrow keys at the root when focus belongs to descendant content.
Do not auto-advance or loop in v1, and respect reduced motion for authored transitions.
Preserve visible focus and native scrolling in forced-colors and RTL contexts.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/layout.css with canonical Icon Button controls; the target owns slide data/current index and synchronizes native scroll, buttons, dots, status, RTL, and finite bounds.

shopify.notes: Liquid owns the finite collection while target JavaScript synchronizes native scroll state and uses the shared Icon Button class contract.
